claims.value: Rapa. Bifacial anthropomorphic dance-paddle carved of toromiro wood (Mimosa sp.) with a flattened 'head' form at one end with stylized facial features merging into a cylindrical hand-grip section broadening out into a flattened 'torso' form ending with a stylized phallus point.
Place: Oceania; Polynesia; Rapa Nui [Easter Island]
Source: HMS Topaz; Newall, Robert Stirling [donor]
